entries.invariant: Indices resolve before mutation, callbacks see their argument window, results are adjusted including multiple results, and failed growth preserves the live prefix and later calls. The pinned open-result sentinel preserves all actual child results after a yielded call and across three nested continuation boundaries; zero and fixed result adjustment retain their separate obligations.
entries.boundaries: Macros must be checked through the pinned headers and their expanded public calls. Merely compiling the macro name does not establish its observable stack effect.

entries.invariant: Raw operations preserve actual key/object identity and bypass handlers; registry/global roots remain live, and public metatable access bypasses Lua protection strings.
entries.boundaries: Warning-state registry ownership and FILE metatable lookup additionally use these operations. Review barrier/root safety through collector regressions, not only a raw read-back.

entries.invariant: Callbacks receive owned argument windows and captured cells, protected errors retain exact values, nested callbacks recover, and non-yieldable calls return synchronously without invoking their supplied continuation. The pinned pseudo-index resolves the actual suspended C closure capture from its saved K after collection; it must not resolve a sibling activation or an unrooted copied argument.
entries.boundaries: This expanded scope requires distinct real evidence for synchronous calls and the selected suspended continuation/coroutine paths. Foreign nonlocal transfers must remain outside active Ada frames. Unrelated full ABI obligations remain pending; historical synchronous witnesses cannot certify yielded K behavior.

entries.invariant: Success, nil, absent optional arguments and actual full userdata remain distinct through public type queries and callback results. Successful synchronous and resumed calls report the actual normal-completion status, distinct from a suspended delivery; completion never reruns an abandoned C body.
entries.boundaries: The T.newuserdata optional-argument checks in tests/c/conformance_adapter.c also exercise lua_isnoneornil. Review invalid/missing arguments independently of successful allocations.
